question: If the product of an odd number of odd integers is of the form $4n+1$, then

options.A: an even number of them must always be of the form $4n+1$.
options.B: an odd number of them must always be of the form $4n+3$.
options.C: an odd number of them must always be of the form $4n+1$.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
